summary: Updated the DeepSeek provider configuration so DeepSeek V4 Pro is the default model shown by LLM connection settings and is available as a selectable model chip.
features_completed: Added provider-level default_model support to the llm_bridge provider descriptor contract.
Set DeepSeek default_model to deepseek-v4-pro and put deepseek-v4-pro first in the DeepSeek model list.
Added DeepSeek V4 Flash plus legacy DeepSeek Chat/Reasoner entries after the new V4 Pro default.
Normalized old stored DeepSeek defaults deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner to deepseek-v4-pro for default display and default generation fallback.
Updated frontend provider status typing so the UI contract includes default_model.
Added llm_bridge registry tests proving DeepSeek V4 Pro is default/selectable and legacy defaults normalize to V4 Pro.
commands_run: bun test in llm_bridge -> passed, 3 tests
bun run typecheck in llm_bridge -> passed
bun /providers payload probe -> passed, DeepSeek default_model deepseek-v4-pro and first models include deepseek-v4-pro
decisions: Used model ID deepseek-v4-pro and display label DeepSeek V4 Pro so the API payload remains machine-safe while the UI shows a readable model name.
Kept deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner as legacy selectable entries after the new V4 models instead of removing them.
Normalized only legacy DeepSeek stored defaults to V4 Pro; arbitrary custom stored model IDs remain untouched.
known_gaps: A credentialed live DeepSeek API call was not run because it requires the user's API key.
If DeepSeek changes the public model ID again, the registry list will need another update.
requirements_covered: DeepSeek V4 Pro selectable in LLM connection settings
DeepSeek V4 Pro shown as the DeepSeek default model
Legacy DeepSeek defaults no longer keep the settings panel on deepseek-chat or deepseek-reasoner
